title: Frontend: seconds-accurate time volume display for Plank and constant Squash across months

requirements.summary: Ensure month-to-month volume display reflects backend-returned seconds-accurate values for Plank and constant values for Squash, without changing other habits’ behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: After saving January volume for Plank as 1:00 (time), switching month tabs shows Feb=1:15, Mar=1:30, etc., matching backend-returned values.
After saving Squash volume as 45:00 (time), switching month tabs shows 45:00 for all months.
No UI regressions for editing volumes of other habits; their display and progression remain unchanged.

file_operations.description: Update optimistic compounding/unit inference so time-based volume edits (timeString provided) initialize and compound as unitType="time" when volumeTracking is missing, preventing temporary reps-based progression in the UI. Keep existing display logic that prefers entry.timeString (seconds-accurate) so Plank renders 1:15, 1:30, etc., and Squash remains constant when backend returns constant values.

Verify optimistic volume update wiring continues to pass timeString through to computeCompoundedVolumeTracking so the UI immediately reflects seconds-accurate Plank compounding and constant Squash values across month tabs, while preserving existing behavior for other habits.
